Local bakery celebrates 50 years

By Sam O'Neill | Staff Writer

September 14, 2026

For half a century the bakery on Main Street has opened its doors before dawn, and on Saturday hundreds of residents lined up for free pastries to mark the anniversary of the family-run shop.

The owners, now in their third generation, say the recipes for their signature rye bread and cinnamon rolls have barely changed since the founders arrived in town with a single oven and a borrowed delivery van.

Longtime customers shared stories of birthday cakes and wedding orders, and the city presented the family with a plaque recognizing their contribution to downtown life over five decades.
